items.originalEnglish: I feel completely run down by my role as a parent
items.workingChinese: 作为父母，我感到自己已经完全筋疲力尽。

items.originalEnglish: I have the sense that I'm really worn out as a parent
items.workingChinese: 我感觉自己作为父母真的已经累垮了。

items.originalEnglish: I'm so tired out by my role as a parent that sleeping doesn't seem like enough
items.workingChinese: 做父母让我累得似乎连睡觉都不足以恢复过来。

items.originalEnglish: When I get up in the morning and have to face another day with my child(ren), I feel exhausted before I've even started
items.workingChinese: 早上起床，想到又要和孩子度过一天，我还没开始就已经觉得精疲力尽了。

items.originalEnglish: I find it exhausting just thinking of everything I have to do for my child(ren)
items.workingChinese: 只要想到要为孩子做的所有事情，我就觉得疲惫不堪。

items.originalEnglish: I have zero energy for looking after my child(ren)
items.workingChinese: 我一点照顾孩子的精力都没有了。

items.originalEnglish: My role as a parent uses up all my resources
items.workingChinese: 做父母这件事耗尽了我所有可以调动的资源。

items.originalEnglish: I sometimes have the impression that I'm looking after my child(ren) on autopilot
items.workingChinese: 有时我觉得自己像开着自动驾驶一样照顾孩子。

items.originalEnglish: I'm in survival mode in my role as a parent
items.workingChinese: 在做父母这件事上，我正处在勉强撑下去的“生存模式”。

items.originalEnglish: I don't think I'm the good father/mother that I used to be to my child(ren)
items.workingChinese: 我觉得对孩子来说，我已经不再是以前那个好爸爸／好妈妈了。

items.originalEnglish: I tell myself that I'm no longer the parent I used to be
items.workingChinese: 我告诉自己，我已经不再是以前那个做父母的自己了。

items.originalEnglish: I'm ashamed of the parent that I've become
items.workingChinese: 对于自己变成了现在这样的父母，我感到羞愧。

items.originalEnglish: I'm no longer proud of myself as a parent
items.workingChinese: 作为父母，我不再为自己感到自豪。

items.originalEnglish: I have the impression that I'm not myself any more when I'm interacting with my child(ren)
items.workingChinese: 和孩子相处时，我觉得自己已经不像自己了。

items.originalEnglish: I feel as though I've lost my direction as a dad/mum
items.workingChinese: 我觉得自己已经失去了做爸爸／妈妈的方向。

items.originalEnglish: I can't stand my role as father/mother any more
items.workingChinese: 我再也忍受不了自己作为爸爸／妈妈的角色了。

items.originalEnglish: I can't take being a parent any more
items.workingChinese: 做父母这件事，我再也承受不了了。

items.originalEnglish: I feel like I can't take any more as a parent
items.workingChinese: 作为父母，我觉得自己再也撑不下去了。

items.originalEnglish: I feel like I can't cope as a parent
items.workingChinese: 作为父母，我觉得自己已经应付不过来了。

items.originalEnglish: I don't enjoy being with my child(ren)
items.workingChinese: 和孩子在一起时，我感受不到乐趣。

items.originalEnglish: I do what I'm supposed to do for my child(ren), but nothing more
items.workingChinese: 我只做那些应该为孩子做的事，不会再做更多。

items.originalEnglish: Outside the usual routines (lifts in the car, bedtime, meals), I'm no longer able to make an effort for my child(ren)
items.workingChinese: 除了日常的例行事务（开车接送、就寝、吃饭），我已经没有能力再为孩子付出更多努力。

items.originalEnglish: I'm no longer able to show my child(ren) how much I love them
items.workingChinese: 我已经没有能力向孩子表达我有多么爱他们。

options.label: a few times a year or less

administration.instructionsZh: 下面的问题关注你作为父母的感受，而不是评价孩子。请根据自己的实际体验，选择每种感受出现的频率。没有对错答案，不愿作答时可以暂停或退出。爱孩子和感到疲惫可以同时存在。
administration.instructionProvenance: New platform introduction, not verbatim author instruction. Does not add a fixed recall window.
administration.timeframe: No fixed retrospective interval in 2018 published PBA description; frequency from never to every day. Do NOT add past 2 weeks/month.
administration.orderBasis: 2018 published Table 1 grouped order; do not claim this is the 2018 administered survey random/order schedule.
administration.respondent: Adult parent rating their own parenting experience, not rating the child; original study required >=1 child still living at home.

sourceVersion: Exact 2018 Frontiers Table 1 English wording and grouped source order EX1–9, CO1–6, FU1–5, ED1–3; independent Chinese translation. This is not the shuffled current author PDF or the author-hosted Chinese translation. DRAFT/HIDDEN pending expert review.
